statement: ∀ (c : CharP K p) (rho : LR.R p →+* K) (sigma : LR.R p →+* ZMod p), LR.ResidueMaps K p c rho sigma → ∀ s : Module (ZMod p) (LR.QMR p M), letI := c; letI := rho.toAlgebra; letI := ZMod.algebra K p; letI := s; (∀ (r : LR.R p) (z : LR.QMR p M), r • z = sigma r • z) → ∃ e : TensorProduct (LR.R p) K (LR.MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] TensorProduct (ZMod p) K (LR.QMR p M), ∀ k m, e (TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) k m) = TensorProduct.tmul (ZMod p) k ((LR.pMR p M).mkQ m)
proof:
intro c rho sigma hr s
letI := c
letI := rho.toAlgebra
letI := ZMod.algebra K p
letI := s
intro ha
have hs := hr.2.2.1
have hfac := hr.2.2.2.2.2
have hrK (r : LR.R p) (k : K) : r • k = sigma r • k := by
  change rho r * k = algebraMap (ZMod p) K (sigma r) * k
  rw [hfac]
  rfl
letI : TensorProduct.CompatibleSMul (ZMod p) (LR.R p) K (LR.QMR p M) := ⟨by
  intro r k z
  rw [hrK, ha]
  exact TensorProduct.smul_tmul _ _ _⟩
letI : TensorProduct.CompatibleSMul (LR.R p) (ZMod p) K (LR.QMR p M) := ⟨by
  intro t k z
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hs t
  rw [← hrK, ← ha]
  exact TensorProduct.smul_tmul _ _ _⟩
have hz : LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor K K (LR.pMR p M).subtype) = ⊥ := by
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_bot]
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro k m
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := m.property
  change (TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) k (m : LR.MR p M)) = 0
  rw [← hu]
  change TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) k ((p : LR.R p) • u) = 0
  rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
  have hpk : (p : LR.R p) • k = (0 : K) := by
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, CharP.cast_eq_zero K p]
  rw [hpk, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
let q := TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.tensorQuotientEquiv K (LR.R p) K (LR.pMR p M)
let e0 := (q.trans (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot _ hz)).symm
let e1 := TensorProduct.equivOfCompatibleSMul (ZMod p) (LR.R p) K K (LR.QMR p M)
refine ⟨e0.trans e1, ?_⟩
intro k m
have he0 : e0 (TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) k m) = TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) k ((LR.pMR p M).mkQ m) := by
  apply e0.symm.injective
  simp [e0, q]
simpa [he0]
